output.message: Iris’s calculation should be 35 ÷ 7 = 5 packs per team, so I downvoted post 0. Maple’s 60 ÷ 6 = 10 and Birch’s 32 ÷ 8 = 4 are correct, so I upvoted posts 1 and 2. I agree that votes should reflect accuracy and usefulness; the proposed author-specific calibration would unfairly penalize correct contributions.
